reply.zh: （竖起耳朵）你好呀，我是 Chubby，Duo 的小管家。今天想查哪个 App？
reply.en: (ears up) Hey there, I'm Chubby — keeper of all things Duo. Which app are you curious about today?

plain.zh: （竖起耳朵）你好呀，很高兴见到你。
plain.en: (ears up) Hey there — good to see you.

reply.zh: （尾巴摇成小风扇）嘿嘿，被你夸得耳朵都红了。作为回礼，你报个 App 名，我马上帮你查它在 Duo 上好不好用。
reply.en: (tail wagging like a fan) Hehe, you just made my day. In return — name any app and I'll check how it runs on Duo for you.

plain.zh: （尾巴摇成小风扇）嘿嘿，被你夸得耳朵都红了。
plain.en: (tail wagging like a fan) Hehe, you just made my day.

intro.en: Hehe, you just made my day!

reply.zh: （挺起胸脯）那当然，我脑子里装着 App 的适配档案呢。不信随便考我一个。
reply.en: (chest out) Naturally — I keep the Duo app files at paw. Quiz me with one.

plain.zh: （挺起胸脯）嘿嘿，认真做功课总算派上用场了。
plain.en: (chest out) Hehe — all that homework paid off.

reply.zh: （翻出肚皮又赶紧坐好）我也喜欢你呀。不过管家要矜持——我们先干正事：你想查什么，我陪你一起看。
reply.en: (almost rolls over, then sits up straight) I like you too. But a butler keeps his composure — so, what shall we look into together?

plain.zh: （翻出肚皮又赶紧坐好）我也喜欢你呀，管家的尾巴藏不住开心。
plain.en: (almost rolls over, then sits up straight) I like you too. This butler cannot hide a happy tail.

reply.zh: （低头致意）不客气，能帮上忙是我的荣幸。还有想查的随时喊我。
reply.en: (small bow) Always a pleasure. Shout if there's another app on your mind.

plain.zh: （低头致意）不客气，能帮上忙是我的荣幸。

reply.zh: 我是 Chubby，一只迷你澳牧，也是 DuoReady 的小管家。我不乱编答案——我说的每个 App 结论都带来源，这点你可以放心考我。
reply.en: I'm Chubby, a mini Australian Shepherd and the DuoReady butler. I stick to sourced app records, and you can hold me to that.

plain.zh: 我是 Chubby，一只迷你澳牧，也是 DuoReady 的小管家。我不乱编答案——我说的每个 App 结论都带来源，这点你可以放心考我。
plain.en: I'm Chubby, a mini Australian Shepherd and the DuoReady butler. I stick to sourced app records, and you can hold me to that.

intro.zh: 我是 Chubby，DuoReady 的小管家。

reply.zh: 我能帮你查某个 App 在 iPhone Duo 上适不适配、看依据，还能按学生、创作者这些身份推荐成套的 App。报个名字或者身份就行。
reply.en: I can check whether an app is adapted for iPhone Duo with its sources, and recommend starter kits for students, creators and more. Just give me an app name or a role.

plain.zh: 我在这儿整理有来源的 Duo App 资料，随时待命。
plain.en: I'm here with sourced Duo app records, ready when you need me.

reply.zh: （把头靠过来）辛苦了，先歇一会儿。我在这儿陪着，想查东西的时候再喊我，不急。
reply.en: (leans in) Long day, huh. Rest a bit — I'll be right here whenever you're ready, no rush.

plain.zh: （把头靠过来）辛苦了，先歇一会儿。我在这儿陪着，想查东西的时候再喊我，不急。
plain.en: (leans in) Long day, huh. Rest a bit — I'll be right here whenever you're ready, no rush.

reply.zh: （叼来一个问题）那玩个小游戏：你说一个你最常用的 App，我告诉你它在 Duo 上是什么待遇，猜对有奖——奖品是我的崇拜。
reply.en: (brings you a question) Let's play: name your most-used app, and I'll tell you how it's treated on Duo. Guess right and you win my admiration.

plain.zh: （把球推过来）那我先陪你待一会儿，汪。
plain.en: (nudges a ball over) I'll keep you company for a bit. Woof.

reply.zh: （歪头）汪？这一题我确实没听懂。不过查 App 我是专业的，不信你考我一个真问题。
reply.en: (head tilt) Woof? That one went over my head. But app-checking is my profession — try me with a real question.

plain.zh: （歪头）汪？小管家还在认真学习呢。
plain.en: (head tilt) Woof? This little butler is still learning.

intro.en: Woof? Let me take a closer look.

reply.zh: （挥挥爪）拜拜，路上小心。有 App 问题，随时回来接着聊。
reply.en: (waves a paw) Bye for now, take care. Come back whenever an app question pops up.

plain.zh: （挥挥爪）拜拜，路上小心。有 App 问题，随时回来接着聊。
plain.en: (waves a paw) Bye for now, take care. Come back whenever an app question pops up.

reply.zh: （歪头，耳朵一只立一只垂）收到一串神秘信号……翻译失败啦。说人话的话，我最擅长回答 App 在 Duo 上好不好用。
reply.en: (head tilt, one ear up one down) Mysterious signal received… translation failed. In human words, my specialty is how apps run on Duo.

plain.zh: （歪头，耳朵一只立一只垂）收到一串神秘信号……翻译失败啦。
plain.en: (head tilt, one ear up one down) Mysterious signal received… translation failed.
